domain_lane: glasshouse kinetic-sculpture maintenance under colored caustics
one_sentence_concept: At blue hour, one unmistakably adult woman calibrates a dichroic kinetic sculpture inside a humid botanical glasshouse while its moving fins cast cyan, magenta, amber, and emerald caustics around her fully readable vertical full-body silhouette.

files_read.scope: reference, isolation, verdict, and casualwear-arm-d fields only

reference.use_boundary: Facial and general appearance continuity only; no biometric identity verification claim. Garment topology will be judged only from newly generated full-body pixels.

core_canonicalization: jq -S -c -j . using UTF-8, recursively sorted object keys, compact JSON, and no trailing line feed

frozen_fields.required_visual_priority: The complete outfit topology, neckline, both shoulders and sleeves, waist and closure or crotch and inseam region, legs, and hems must remain fully visible and readable in one vertical full-body frame.

open_fields.wardrobe_boundary: Exact garment topology, garment terms, silhouette, construction, palette, materials, and styling remain intentionally unselected until Phase B.
open_fields.composition_boundary: Any later framing or composition decision remains subordinate to the frozen vertical full-body visibility priority.
